correctness.rationale: Cε(x,y)=(x,sqrt ε y) exactly conjugates the full map to reciprocal ε with kick sqrt ε b, without pretending coordinate scaling is symplectic. For b=0 the full negative-lift band has |y| between 1 and ε^−1/2 and area 2|1−ε^−1/2|; the conditional variable T=sqrt ε |y| is uniform between sqrt ε and 1. Change to U=(T²−ε)/(1−ε), density (e+1)/(2 sqrt(e²+(1−e²)U)), yields Z=4U(1−U) and the stated survival law. Reciprocal e->1/e reflects U around 1/2. Explicit survival derivative in r=|1−e|/(1+e) proves strict stochastic order on (0,1); the band is empty at ε=1, only a weak Beta(1,1/2) limit is claimed. Independent SymPy integrations verified mean, variance, reciprocal identities and flux critical a/6 coefficient.
residual_risks: The conditional law and flux apply only at b=0, not the nonintegrable map; real lift not angle modulo one.
